newsitem.title: USA: Capital goods stocks up on Smith Barney upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Capital goods stocks up on Smith Barney upgrade.

text.p: Stocks of four U.S. capital goods manufacturers rose sharply Wednesday after they were upgraded by Smith Barney.
Analysts said they did not see other fundamental reasons for the rise in Caterpillar Inc, Case Corp, Parker-Hannifin Corp and Deere & Co.

"Nothing in the fundamentals has changed as far as we can tell," said Lisa Shalett, analyst at Sanford C. Bernstein & Co, when asked if there was a reason for the stocks to move other than the Smith Barney upgrade.
Smith Barney raised Deere and Parker-Hannifin to outperform from neutral and Case and Caterpillar to buy from neutral, a source at the firm said.
Market sources said Smith Barney moved the group to an overweight orientation, saying the 1997 U.S. market outlook looks good, while the European market is likely to recover by mid-1997.
Caterpillar shares rose 3-7/8 to 77-7/8, Case rose 2 to 52-1/8, Parker-Hannifin rose 7/8 to 41-1/8 and Deere rose 1-3/8 to 44-3/4 Wednesday.
